correctness.rationale: Algebraic reduction follows from all three original fixed-point equations. The monotone inverse responses exist uniquely on 10/3<h<10. Nonzero det(I-J) allows implicit-function continuation; only local conclusions are asserted.

value.rationale: Exact full-coexistence multiplicity, with different local dynamical stability under identical parameters and persistence on an open region, fills a natural gap left by necessary coexistence tests and uniqueness on boundary subsystems. It prevents equating a single coexistence scan or boundary uniqueness with full-equilibrium uniqueness, without overclaiming bistability or ecological generality.
